title: Descent into Fallout
description: A woman in a red jacket and grey jumpsuit descends a damaged concrete staircase carrying a large weapon on her back. The flooded basement below contains floating picture frames, while cracked walls display surreal paintings under dramatic spotlighting.
prompt: A lone woman in a red leather jacket and grey vault suit walks down a broken concrete staircase into a flooded basement, carrying a large futuristic weapon on her back. Cracked walls hold surreal floating paintings, some frames drift in the dark reflective water below. Dramatic spotlight from above illuminates dust and debris, eerie post-apocalyptic atmosphere with glowing green and purple accents, highly detailed cinematic digital painting.
